_comment: Shard plan for the asan leg of .github/workflows/loom.yml (read by .github/scripts/asan_shards.py). Presets, not rules.
shards: ordered list; 'tests' are fnmatch patterns over CTest names (an exact name is a pattern); the shard with rest=true takes every test no other shard lists, so a new test lands there on its own.
The number of shards is the length of this list: add a shard (or move names) to change it; the CI matrix follows.
Seeded from run 284 (asan, main f025ed34): test step 140 min, 514 min of tests over 4 slots; durations measured under 4-way contention, cli.smoke (495 s) from the log of run 38528837225.
Tests of >=150 s were spread over the first two shards by longest-processing-time; the many short ones stay in rest. Re-balance from a newer log with: asan_shards.py dryrun --durations ...
Open: a stale pattern raises an advisory, not an error.
